subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-page Group by channel behavior, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main covers channel grouping only; choosing a merged timeline and separated tab model requires maintainer UX, privacy, and Gateway/session semantics.

options.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide Group by channel plus per-session chat navigation is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if one broader sessions workspace should own channel views too.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the closest current-main implementation and recent related Control UI session navigation work.
